prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in League City, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1497; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can use the claim file.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where and when the accident happened?
A: It was on a weekday afternoon, at an intersection in League City, Texas. I was turning left off the main road into a shopping center.
Q: What were you driving, and how fast were you going?
A: My sedan. I was going slowly, maybe fifteen miles an hour, because I was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not clearly. I remember the headlights coming toward me, but I thought there was enough room. I started to turn.
Q: Were you using your turn signal?
A: Yes, I'm pretty sure I had it on for a while before I entered the intersection.
Q: Describe the impact.
A: It hit the front passenger side of my car. My head struck the window frame. The airbag deployed.
Q: Did you receive medical treatment?
A: Yes, I was taken by ambulance to the emergency room. They diagnosed a concussion. I've had headaches, dizziness, and trouble concentrating since then.
Q: Are you still under a doctor's care?
A: Yes, I have follow-up appointments, and I've been told to limit screen time and driving until I'm cleared.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was trying to be careful. I didn't see the other car as a threat until it was too late to stop.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
